five_second.sells: online courses in meditative pattern-drawing and 'manifesting' art (Neurographica, Zentangle-style Zendala, chakra drawing)
five_second.for_whom: people wanting a calming, therapeutic creative practice / personal growth

features_used.moment: On the Zendala course page I found 'Pay in US dollars' / 'Pay in British pounds' links side by side and used the pounds one.
Browsed the Courses page and scrolled through titles - Membership, 7 Chakras, Tangle with Ann, Power of Spirals - before picking one to look at closer.
Clicked the £28/month membership option to compare it against the course, and found a rolling subscription with a 3-day trial and card required upfront instead of a one-time gift price.
Filled in my email and name on the Tangle with Ann checkout and watched the price stay at £75.00 GBP all the way down to the Stripe card fields.

features_looked_for_but_missing: an explicit 'send this as a gift' option with a recipient email and gift message field
a currency selector visible on the homepage or store page itself, rather than only appearing once you open a single course
feature_that_most_helped_the_decision: The 'Pay in British pounds' toggle on the course page, which carried through unchanged to '£75.00 GBP' at the checkout and card form.
feature_that_most_hurt_the_decision: The membership's checkout turned out to be a rolling monthly subscription (£28/month, 3-day trial, card required now) rather than a one-off gift price, which ruled it out for a clean gift.

friction.moment: No price appeared anywhere on the homepage or first two scrolls of the Courses page - I had to click into an individual course before any number showed up.
The Zendala pattern course is taught by a different named person (Ann Diane Tai) than the site's namesake Anna Denning, which was momentarily confusing on a site branded 'Anna Denning'.
Even after choosing to pay in pounds, the checkout's Country field defaulted to United States, which felt like a small mismatch.
The membership presented as a rolling monthly subscription with a 3-day trial rather than a simple one-off gift, and there was no 'gift' option anywhere on the site for either product.

delight.moment: Seeing '£75.00 GBP' and 'TANGLE WITH ANN £75' agree with each other right down to the Stripe card form, with no dollar sign in sight once I'd chosen pounds.
Finding a named, credentialed teacher (Certified Zentangle Teacher, co-authored books) behind the pattern-drawing course, which made the £75 feel justified.

what_earned_it: the pound price stayed identical from the course page to the checkout to the card form
a named, credentialed teacher bio for the course I chose
a Stripe-powered checkout with recognizable card logos and SSL messaging
trust.what_it_would_take: an explicit 'send as a gift' checkbox with a recipient email/message field, and the country field defaulting to United Kingdom once I've chosen to pay in pounds

brand_recall.tell_a_friend_one_sentence: It's one woman's online school for calming pattern-drawing and 'manifesting' art courses, and refreshingly, once I picked pounds the price actually stayed pounds all the way to the card box.
brand_recall.product_remembered: Tangle with Ann (the Zendala pattern-drawing course)
